items.title: Cinematic Night Meadow Flash Portrait
items.prompt: Do not change the facial features, proportions, hair color, or skin tone. Maintain 100% likeness. Preserve natural knitted fabric texture, correct human anatomy, exactly two arms, exactly two hands, exactly two legs, and exactly two feet. Each hand must have exactly five fingers with no duplicated limbs, extra fingers, extra legs, AI artifacts, or plastic-looking skin. Keep natural human imperfections. The uploaded reference image controls everything except the woman's identity. The camera angle must remain almost perfectly side-on (85–90°), and the composition should match the reference almost exactly. The woman should remain relatively small within the frame, while the meadow dominates the composition. The scene should show a {argument name="environment" default="night meadow"} with a {argument name="sky condition" default="dark sky"} and soft moonlight touching the grass. The blanket should remain barely visible. The overall atmosphere should feel calm, nostalgic, and cinematic, capturing the silence of the night and cool air. The colours should remain muted, slightly dark, and film-like, with a deep nighttime palette and subdued tones. The time of day is deep night, with a dark sky, faint moonlight barely reaching the meadow, and long shadows created by the grass. A camera flash hits directly on the girl, creating sharp directional lighting that pulls her figure out of the darkness, with deep shadows behind her and the background fading into the night. Her skin should reflect the flash with a glassy oil-skin effect, featuring natural highlights on the cheekbones, nose, forehead, and shoulders while preserving realistic skin pores and texture. The girl suddenly turns her head toward the camera, creating motion blur from the movement, with slight blur on the hair and edges of the face while keeping her identity recognizable and her gaze captured mid-motion. Use high ISO settings with realistic digital sensor noise, slight flash overexposure on the figure and nearby grass, and a realistic RAW photography feel. The final image should be almost indistinguishable from a genuine Canon EOS R5 RAW lifestyle photograph captured in a quiet park at night. Ultra photorealistic, cinematic realism. The manicure should be {argument name="nails" default="short square-shaped milky French style"}. --ar 9:16 --style raw --style motion 50
